title: Best UGC Ad Creators (2026): Authentic Video Ads That Convert
description: How to hire a UGC ad creator for TikTok, Instagram and Meta ads: usage rights, hooks, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: UGC ads are short videos made by creators in a natural, social-media style, then used as paid ads. They often feel more trustworthy than polished commercials. Problems start when the ad rights are not agreed, the hook is weak, or the video does not follow ad platform rules. This guide helps you order UGC ads you can actually run.

faq.q: What is the difference between UGC videos and UGC ads?
faq.a: UGC videos can be for organic posts. UGC ads are made to run as paid ads, so they need strong hooks, clear calls to action and paid usage rights.

faq.q: What usage rights do I need?
faq.a: Agree on paid ad use, which platforms, how long, and whether you can edit the video. Rights for organic posting alone are not enough for ads.

faq.q: Do I need to send the product?
faq.a: Usually yes, so the creator can show it honestly. Plan shipping time into your deadline.

faq.q: How many versions should I order?
faq.a: Ads are often tested with several hooks or lengths. Ordering a few variations from one shoot is efficient.

faq.q: Can the creator say anything about my product?
faq.a: Claims must be true and allowed by ad platforms. Give the creator approved key points and avoid exaggerated promises.
